answer: Yes, after exposing a label inconsistency in the printed Appendix C. As printed, Eq. (31) cannot imply both Eqs. (32) and (33). Exchanging a1 and a2 in Eq. (31) repairs both. Expanding Eq. (16) then fixes the two-annihilator order-lambda kernel. Its t and t^2 terms cancel exactly after the repaired leading map is inverted onto the Omega/Upsilon carrier. The resulting fixed-splitting kernel is time independent and has a formal anti-Krein cubic lift, but its off-diagonal Gram has cubic endpoint poles. A distributional endpoint extension and full projector trace are still required.
